boundary_action: existing metric completion plus an open S_Sigma_core; scalar Dirichlet data need no new bulk cancellation term
bulk_phase_audit: U'(0)=0 is optional and unproved; no regular second vacuum is selected
core_boundary_audit: preferred ontology; upsilon=0 is boundary data on Sigma_core

coupling_ledger.boundary_term: -integral_Sigma sqrt|h| n_A Z nabla^A upsilon delta upsilon
coupling_ledger.mass_dimension: 6 in D=8 when upsilon is dimensionless
coupling_ledger.new_parameter: at least one positive normalization relative to kappa_1
coupling_ledger.stress_tensor: Z nabla_A upsilon nabla_B upsilon-G_AB[1/2 Z|nabla upsilon|^2]
coupling_ledger.term: -1/2 Z_upsilon(upsilon) G^AB nabla_A upsilon nabla_B upsilon

coupling_ledger.reason_required: not required for hyperbolicity; constrained only if a restoring branch is claimed

coupling_ledger.domain: common parent localization of the q_C invariant
coupling_ledger.mass_dimension: dimensionless F_C multiplying the inherited X_C density
coupling_ledger.reason_required: q_D must respond to q_C rather than remain a spectator
coupling_ledger.symmetry: requires X_C to be an action-owned scalar

coupling_ledger.domain: common parent localization of the q_W/fold invariant
coupling_ledger.mass_dimension: dimensionless F_W multiplying the inherited X_W density
coupling_ledger.reason_required: q_D must respond to q_W rather than remain a spectator
coupling_ledger.symmetry: requires X_W to be an action-owned scalar

curvature_coupling: F_R(upsilon)R_8 is allowed but not required or selected; it changes the gravity constraint
eta_coupling: no direct F_eta term selected without a common action-owned invariant

new_parameter_audit.cosmic_anchor_role: can convert units only after a dimensionless action is selected; cannot choose its dimensionless ratio
new_parameter_audit.dimension: mass^6 relative to the D=8 curvature coefficient kappa_1
new_parameter_audit.kinetic_normalization: unavoidable for a propagating dimensionless order parameter; relative value is not fixed by topology

sigma_coupling: no direct F_sigma term selected without a common action-owned invariant
stress_tensor: T_AB^upsilon=Z nabla_A upsilon nabla_B upsilon-G_AB[1/2 Z|nabla upsilon|^2+U]+T_AB^coupling
wall_coupling: required in class through F_W X_W, coefficient/function open
